## 01 – Alert Intake (owner: Vishwa)
Alertmanager → validate → de-duplicate → respond 202 → create incident (**BLOCKED: BD-1**) → run 05 Root Cause for every new alert.
Auth: Header Auth credential "Alertmanager Webhook Token" (Alertmanager sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

nodes.name: Parse and validate alerts
nodes.notes: Firing alerts only; resolved alerts are acknowledged.

nodes.name: Detect duplicate alerts
nodes.notes: fingerprint + startsAt, kept DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES (static data; production executions only).

nodes.name: Accepted response
nodes.notes: Adds the HTTP status for the response.

nodes.name: Respond 202
nodes.notes: Answers Alertmanager before the long investigation starts.

nodes.name: Create incident (backend) – BLOCKED
nodes.notes: BLOCKED (BD-1): no backend endpoint creates incidents from alerts. No URL is invented.

nodes.name: Run 05 Root Cause
nodes.notes: One sub-workflow run per new alert.
